title: Anyone have tools for realtime collab?
author: Own_Zookeepergame_74
selftext:
I'm working on a game and my brother really wants to help with the process he has really good ideas and I'd like to bring him aboard. We both have our own ai accounts we can use which would mean double the available tokens but there doesn't appear to be a sort of Google-docs for vibe coding. By that I mean a way for two people to work on the same code at the same time and see/test the updates right away.

Something that works inside of vscode as an extension would be ideal. Anybody have any suggestions?

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: github is a standard way to collaborate. you can roll back changes etc.

comments.author: AgenticGameDev
comments.body: And modulurize what you work on. One on player movement and one on game manager and so on. Don’t work at the same area and think how can I make this as modularized as possible.

comments.author: insanetheta
comments.body: Project tracking, beads is great for this.  Have your agents always create beads for any new work items and always check those beads into git.  Then you should be able to quickly reference what the other is doing

comments.author: SubjectHealthy2409
comments.body: Zed IDE has multiplayer collab iirc

comments.author: FitReaction1072
comments.body: I can’t believe even as a vibe coder you are “working” on a game and never heard git or github.

replies.author: je386
replies.body:
Oh my. I thought they would ask for pair programming tools like idea intellij has built in, but thats for looking at the code.

Yes, if you just want to share code, git and github is good.

If you want to work together, idea intellij

replies.author: Cassp3
replies.body: The irony in the fact they could just ask the AI for the simple answer.

comments.author: BigWetDeck
comments.body: I'm working on an engine that has it built in, plus built in Ai, I'm setting up a beta pretty soon and would love feed back. PyreForge is the platform. Beta is byok for Ai copilot and asset generation but release has option of cloud gpu and baked in Ai, however everything is planned free with your own hardware

replies.author: BigWetDeck
replies.body: Just double checked current state and in beta currently PyreForge  will let teams edit a project together live, then save those shared changes into Git as intentional commits and pushes so you get both real-time collaboration and proper version history
